Messages.Author: Kulaid
Messages.Body:
I know if you psyche a battle after somebody Form of Mist, would
interrupt the FoM... My question is... Shouldn't it work if you
force of will too?

It states,
Force of Will
Cardtype: Action

Cost: 1 blood

Discipline: Fortitude

Only usable by a tapped vampire.
[for] (D) Bleed with +1 bleed. This vampire takes 2 points of
aggravated damage (damage not preventable) even if the action is
blocked. Damage occurs after the action or combat is resolved.
[FOR] As above, but with +2 bleed, and the acting vampire takes only 1
point of aggravated damage (damage not preventable).

The acting vampire chooses when it resolved, after combat or action...
So if the acting minion chooses to take it after combat, but
psyches... Won't getting the agg damage be interrupted? Similarly to
the how form of mist, or other strike combat ends and continue the
action cards gets interrupted with psyche?

If psyche interrupts a FoM... Can you FoM at SUP again in the next
combat, since the first one was interrupted?!? Or does it still
considered an action modifier?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Kulaid wrote:
> I know if you psyche a battle after somebody Form of Mist, would
> interrupt the FoM... My question is... Shouldn't it work if you
> force of will too?
>
> It states,
> Force of Will
> Cardtype: Action
>
> Cost: 1 blood
>
> Discipline: Fortitude
>
> Only usable by a tapped vampire.
> [for] (D) Bleed with +1 bleed. This vampire takes 2 points of
> aggravated damage (damage not preventable) even if the action is
> blocked. Damage occurs after the action or combat is resolved.
> [FOR] As above, but with +2 bleed, and the acting vampire takes only 1
> point of aggravated damage (damage not preventable).
>
> The acting vampire chooses when it resolved, after combat or action...

No choice. It goes after. At the end of the action.

> So if the acting minion chooses to take it after combat, but
> psyches... Won't getting the agg damage be interrupted? Similarly to
> the how form of mist, or other strike combat ends and continue the
> action cards gets interrupted with psyche?

It will delay the damage yes.

The damage will still be still be done at the end of the action.
It is not something that is contingent on the end of combat.

> If psyche interrupts a FoM... Can you FoM at SUP again in the next
> combat, since the first one was interrupted?!? Or does it still
> considered an action modifier?

No, it is still considered an action modifier.
